_note: Release config for THIS repo, read by bin/promote-cards-by-token. DELIBERATELY MINIMAL: it carries only keys something in this repo actually READS — `tag_format` (the mover's last-release-tag glob) and `promote` (board correlation + the two stage-id sets). Do NOT 'complete' it with main_branch/dev_branch/version_file/version_regex/artifacts: nothing here reads them today, README.md already owns the branch model, and a second copy would be free to drift with nothing binding it. Add a key when a consumer for it lands, not before. SECURITY: `promote.api_base` is where KANBAN_WRITEBACK_TOKEN is sent, and this file is PR-editable — so the committed value is a HOST-SCRUBBED PLACEHOLDER. The real base arrives at run time from the repo variable KANBAN_API_BASE (out-of-band from this file), and the mover's host guard fail-closes against the repo variable KANBAN_EXPECTED_HOST before any token leaves the runner. Treat ANY edit to api_base as a credential-scope change and review it as one.

promote._note: Board 14 (PupFuzz mezzanine) on the fleet kanban. These are BOARD STATE, not config: re-read them from GET /api/v3/boards/14.json after any board restructure. A wrong-but-resolving stage id moves cards to the wrong column SILENTLY.
